description: Apple Watch to iPhone capture hand-off, schema 1. The watch enqueue produces envelopeMetadata; the phone import reads it and answers with an acknowledgement. Each value is the exact dictionary WatchConnectivity carries: a JSON string under one key. WatchCaptureWireContractTests (SpeakWatchCoreTests) and WatchCaptureImportWireContractTests (SpeakCoreTests) both read this file.
